summary_en: Interim dividend raised to 42 yen per share from 40 yen, and full-year FY2027 dividend forecast revised upward to 84 yen per share from 80 yen, with payout ratio of 40.1% based on upgraded earnings guidance.
title_en: Notice regarding Interim Dividend Payment (Dividend Increase) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Daishi Hokuetsu Financial Group announced increases to both interim and full-year dividend guidance for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend (second quarter) was raised to 42 yen per share from the previously announced 40 yen, effective December 1, 2026. Simultaneously, the year-end dividend forecast was revised upward to 42 yen per share from 40 yen, resulting in a full-year dividend of 84 yen per share compared to the prior forecast of 80 yen. This dividend increase was driven by an upward revision to full-year earnings guidance announced on the same date.

The revised full-year dividend payout ratio is 40.1%, aligned with the company's capital allocation policy targeting a payout ratio of approximately 40%. The company noted that interim dividend history shows 27 yen in the prior year (FY2026) and 36 yen for the full year, with prior-year figures adjusted for a 3-for-1 stock split effective October 1, 2025. The company maintains a dividend policy emphasizing progressive increases per share while strengthening internal reserves to support ongoing profitability and a target return on equity exceeding 10%.
